TheRocket SGrid Pro - release build
===================================

  The same grid engine as TheRocket SGrid, with every setting exposed:
  grid, lot ladder, trading hours, velocity filter, stochastic filter,
  trend filter and recovery - 71 settings in nine groups.
  It is meant for someone who tunes and backtests their own configuration.
  If you want it to just run, use TheRocket SGrid instead.

FILES
  TheRocketSGridPro.ex5   the Expert Advisor - this is the only file to install
  INSTALL.txt             this file

INSTALL
  1. In MT5: File > Open Data Folder > MQL5 > Experts
  2. Copy TheRocketSGridPro.ex5 into that folder
  3. Back in MT5: right-click Navigator > Refresh

FIRST RUN
  1. Open a XAUUSD chart and switch it to M5.
  2. Drag the EA onto the chart.
  3. In the properties window tick:
       Allow Algo Trading
       Allow DLL imports        (needed for the licence check on a real account)
  4. Press the Algo Trading button on the MT5 toolbar so it turns green.

SETTINGS
  The values the EA starts with are the ones that were tested. Change them only
  against your own backtest, and change one at a time: this strategy is very
  sensitive to the first entry, so two changes at once tell you nothing about
  which one did what.

LICENCE
  Strategy Tester / Demo      free, no time limit
  Real account                the account number must be on the licence list;
                              there is no trial period on this build

  To be licensed, send your MT5 account number. It unlocks within 5 minutes;
  there is no new file to install.

RISK
  This EA averages down and has no stop loss by design. The risk it carries is
  the whole account, not a fixed amount per trade. Use money you can afford to
  lose entirely and keep the lots small. Past results do not describe the
  future: testing was done on a window in which gold rose strongly, and the
  same settings lost money in other periods.
